id: title:gantoine:only warn about a missing support widget on support surfaces

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the PostHog support widget's warning behavior, specifically adding a support-surface check and subscription-level assertion to prevent false-positive warnings.
review.reason: The implementation hunk P1.F1.H1 adds a conditional check and a new state flag before warning, while P1.F1.H2 updates the test assertions and adds a test case for the support-surface check. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it refines the warning condition to account for support-surface availability and subscription status, reducing false positives. No
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and production impact are not demonstrated; this is a test and implementation change without observed production results or broader systemic changes.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test and implementation changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check and a new state flag before warning, and changes the warning condition to include a support-surface check.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the test setup to simulate being on a support surface, while the implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 adds the actual support-surface check and a new state flag. This could prevent false-positive warnings when the widget is unavailable but the user is not on a support surface.
